sentences.en: Various stages in the development of the endogenous spores in a Clostridium - the small letters indicate the order.

sentences.en: The spores, which may be unior multi-cellular, are either abstricted free from the ends of hyphae (acrogenous), or formed from segments in their course (chlamydospores) or from protoplasm in their interior (endogenous).
sentences.vi: Các bào tử, có thể là đơn bào hoặc đa bào, hoặc không bị giới hạn ở đầu sợi nấm (nội sinh), hoặc được hình thành từ các phân đoạn trong quá trình của chúng (bào tử chlamydospore) hoặc từ nguyên sinh chất bên trong chúng (nội sinh).

sentences.en: Production of endogenous erythropoietin is impaired in patients with chronic renal failure and the primary cause of their anemia is due to erythropoietin deficiency.

sentences.en: The influence of protein nutrition on the endogenous excretion was also examined.

sentences.en: We have previously shown that cigarette smoking is associated with endothelial dysfunction and impaired endogenous fibrinolysis.
